"description": ["Musa is a tomboyish and kind girl who originally hails from the realm of Melody. Musa is the fairy of music and acts as Melody's guardian fairy. She is a skilled singer and musician, knowing how to play almost every instrument ever created. Her favorite instrument to play is the concert flute. Musa is one of the founding members of the Winx Club. The other members of the Winx Club are Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, and Musa's best friend Tecna. All the members of the Winx Club, including Musa, are fairies and attend Alfea College for Fairies. Musa has a rocky but passionate relationship with her boyfriend, Riven. Musa's boyfriend attends Red Fountain. Musa usually wears a checkered turquoise long tube top with an orange belt on her hips and teal pants, which include white wrist to elbow sleeves with turquoise cuffs and turquoise sneakers with navy blue soles and her hair is bound together by twin tails with two orange hair ties. When Musa turns into a fairy, her outfit consists of a magenta, pale pink and yellow top that has orange ribbons that hang off to her left or right side, and a braided strap of the same color. Her wings, ample in size, resemble crystals and are yellow with bright purple edges, with purple gems hanging off and accenting them. Musa also wears a puffy skirt with red and magenta colours on an alternating side of diamond-shaped detailing, with the same ribbons. She wears strappy soleless sandals that are bright yellow which reach up to her calves and are fastened with a magenta diamond shaped button. Her hair retains the same hairstyle as her normal outfit but is now tied up by pink scrunchies instead, and seems to have gained a much neater, elegant look and style as her hair and bangs are much straighter, which also has grown several inches in length as well as gaining lavender highlights and now also wears a small gold tiara upon her head. Her arms are covered in sparkly pink see-through gloves and she has a fairy dust bottle in a pink choker around her neck. The fairy dust bottle is a hot pink, bottlenecked container with a hot pink, disc-shaped cap adorned with rectangular, silver studs and an eye hook-type fixture encased in a silver, spherical cage adorned with light pink, flower-shaped charms with a silver center, and the cage closed off with a hot pink, disc-shape with light pink flower-shaped charms on gray strings hanging from it.}]
